title: celtis hasseltii
intro: Celtis hasseltii, commonly known as the Hasselt's treebine or Taiwanese hackberry, is a plant species in the family Cannabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Celtis hasseltii include wound healing, fever reduction, and the alleviation of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Celtis hasseltii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
